title: mRemoteNG Spash screen rendering bug (overlapped)
author: vansanper
body_snippet: **What happens** (and what you expected instead): On startup the Splash Screen with mRemoteNG info is mangled/overlaped/distorted **Steps to reproduce:** 1.Open mRemoteNG 2.See splash screen with incorrect display format 3. **Version and build** (copy Help → About; include portable or installed, x86/x64/ARM64): 1.84.0 Release 3716, installed, x64 (Another bug in About shows portable, but i installed the .msi and the .exe and other files are in C:\Program Files\mRemoteNG)

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the screenshot. Its size, 903×239 on your 200% monitor, gave the cause away.

The splash was a fixed 900×240-pixel box with its text lines at fixed pixel positions, while the text itself is sized in points and doubles at 200%. The text grew and the box did not, so the lines ran into each other. In commit 47ef31f11 the box, the line positions and the logo scale with the monitor's DPI.
